solution:
By the binomial theorem, the general term is $T_{r+1}=\binom{6}{r}3^{6-r}(2x^2)^r$. For the $x^6$ term, $2r=6$, so $r=3$.
$$\text{Coefficient} = \binom{6}{3}3^3 2^3 = 4320.$$
